title: UET: unit test for CRC verification
description:
Add a pcap with UET packets having many combinations of IPv4, IPv6 and
UDP encapsulations (not real world, generated with a Scapy script,
included).  Add a testcase to suite_dissection to verify we compute a
Good CRC for all of them.

This is the unit test portion spun off from !25143 

AI-Assisted: no
Signed-off-by: Alex Badea <alex.badea@keysight.com>

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
This test seems to consistently fail on Big Endian: https://launchpadlibrarian.net/871234387/buildlog_ubuntu-noble-s390x.wireshark_4.7.3-0~202607272128~ubuntu24.04.1_BUILDING.txt.gz
Ah.  Excellent, I guess?  I'll see how to get a big endian build env and take a look.

(for posterity I did `apt-get install qemu-user-static binfmt-support` on host and then just added `--platform linux/s390x` to my `podman {build,run}` incantations)

It's a `g_htonl()` in the CRC compute path, checking...

+
+class TestDissectUltraEthernet:
+    def test_uet_crc(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Verify we compute a good CRC for various IP and UDP encapsulations.'''
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-r', capture_file('uet-generated-crc-encaps.pcap'),
+                '-ouet.has_crc:TRUE',
+                '-ouet.validate_crc:TRUE',
+                '-dip.proto==253,uet',
+                '-Tfields', '-euet.crc.status',
+            ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+        assert stdout.strip().split() == (['1'] * 48)

@@ -0,0 +1,83 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+#
+# Copyright Keysight Technologies 2026
+#
+# Wireshark - Network traffic analyzer
+# By Gerald Combs <gerald@wireshark.org>
+# Copyright 1998 Gerald Combs
+#
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+#
+# Generate various contrived IPv4, IPv6 and UDP encapsulations
+# for UltraEthernet Transport packets with CRC.
+#
+# ruff: noqa: F403, F405
+#
+# Requires:
+# scapy==2.7.0
+# crc32c==2.8
+
+from scapy.all import *
+import crc32c
+
+a='203.0.113.42'
+b='198.51.100.42'
+c='2001:db8::beef'
+d='2001:db8::cafe'
+uet = b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x19\x88\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x0f\x05\x0b\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00\x0f\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x10\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x10\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\xff\xff\xff\xff'
+templates = [
+	IP(src=a, dst=b, proto=253) / Raw(uet),
+	IP(src=a, dst=b) / UDP(sport=4242, dport=4793) / Raw(uet),
+	IPv6(src=c, dst=d, nh=253) / Raw(uet),
+	IPv6(src=c, dst=d) / UDP(sport=4242, dport=4793) / Raw(uet),
+]
+def imaginate(tmpl, first_pass=False):
+	for pkt in tmpl:
+		yield Ether() / pkt
+		yield Ether() / IP(src=b, dst=a) / pkt
+		yield Ether() / IPv6(src=d, dst=c) / pkt
+		if IP in pkt:
+			yield Ether() / IP(src=b, dst=a) / ICMP(type='dest-unreach') / pkt
+			if first_pass:
+				other = pkt.copy()
+				other[IP].options=[IPOption_RR()]
+				yield from imaginate(other)
+		if IPv6 in pkt:
+			yield Ether() / IPv6(src=d, dst=c) / ICMPv6DestUnreach() / pkt
+			if first_pass:
+				other = pkt.copy()
+				rest = other[IPv6].payload
+				other[IPv6].remove_payload()
+				yield from imaginate(other[IPv6] / IPv6ExtHdrHopByHop(options=[RouterAlert()]) / rest)
+				yield from imaginate(other[IPv6] / IPv6ExtHdrDestOpt(options=HAO(hoa="2001:db8::1")) / rest)
+				yield from imaginate(other[IPv6] / IPv6ExtHdrHopByHop(options=[RouterAlert()]) / IPv6ExtHdrDestOpt(options=HAO(hoa="2001:db8::1")) / rest)
+
+idx = 0
+with PcapWriter('_generated.pcap') as pcap:
+	for pkt in imaginate(templates, True):
+		idx += 1
+		print("@@@", idx)
+
+		last = None
+		p = pkt
+		off = 0
+		while p:
+			if issubclass(type(p), IP):
+				last = p
+				off = 12
+			elif issubclass(type(p), IPv6):
+				last = p
+				off = 8
+			p = p.payload
+		print("last:", last)
+		assert last
+		if UDP in last:
+			last[UDP].chksum = 0 # force
+		buf = raw(last)[off:-4] # N.B. assuming placeholder for CRC
+		crc = crc32c.CRC32CHash(data=buf).digest()
+		print("input:", buf.hex())
+		print("CRC:", crc.hex())
+		if UDP in last:
+			last[UDP].chksum = None # recompute
+		last[Raw].load = last[Raw].load[:-4] + crc
+		pcap.write(pkt)

commits_data.message:
UET: dissect and verify CRC

Add a "has_crc" pref (default true) to tell us whether we expect packets
to have CRC at all (this is an out-of-band network-wide configuration).

Add a separate "validate_crc" (default false) for the computation part.

Signed-off-by: Alex Badea <alex.badea@keysight.com>
